einzeiler: GPT-6 Astra arrives, Tesla deploys robotaxis in Austin, and Anthropic proves Fermat's…
kurzfassung: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, bringing major performance gains and computer use capabilities while raising new security and interpretability challenges. Tesla held its cybercab launch event in Austin, highlighting low-cost autonomous transport. Meanwhile, Anthropic launched Fable 5.1 and formalized Fermat's last theorem, demonstrating rapid advancements across math and AI development.
stichpunkte: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra, saturating several benchmarks like Arc-AGI-3 and FrontierMath while introducing native computer use assistance.
Anthropic released Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, scoring exceptionally high on Humanity's Last Exam and formalizing Fermat's last theorem.
Tesla held its cybercab event in Austin, showcasing autonomous two-seaters with a projected price point of thirty thousand dollars.
World Labs released Atlas, a multimodal world model utilizing three-dimensional Gaussian splats for camera-controlled physics simulations.
NASA selected Blue Origin to build the telecommunications relay network on Mars to support future interplanetary missions.
NASA launched the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope to scan the sky for exoplanets and map dark matter distribution.
Research published in Nature showed that semaglutide recapitulates caloric restriction benefits and extends lifespan in mice.
Lawmakers introduced the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act, proposing severe penalties for developing human-level cognitive AI systems.

clips.hook: Who gives a rat's ass about making a video game from the 1970s?
clips.text: One of the hosts criticizes the marketing examples used for advanced AI models, arguing the technology has far broader implications.

clips.hook: Evolution has birthed us for death.
clips.text: The discussion explores how evolutionary biology favored short life cycles to preserve resources for younger generations before modern medicine and longevity breakthroughs.
